messageFlow.summary: WhatsApp message → trigger check (DMs always, most groups only on @mention/prefix/reply, with ambient LQCore agency on the silent group path) → cortex parallel fan-out (classification + memory + identity + dreams + insights + lquorum + speculative web prefetch) → route to local Qwen on EVO by default, with MiniMax and Claude as fallbacks/explicit paths → tool execution loop (up to 5 iterations, web_search checks prefetch cache first) or task planner (multi-step) → response sent. The cortex layer replaced the old sequential pipeline — all intelligence streams now race in parallel, total gather time equals the slowest stream (~1s) instead of the sum of all streams (~3s). Two direct addressing modes remain: 'clawd' for full advisory mode (planner available), 'clawdsec' for secretary/admin mode (single-tool fast path). Ambient LQCore participation uses a separate intervention engine, not the normal addressed-message trigger path.

router.layer1: 4B classifier (PRIMARY) — Qwen3-4B on EVO port 8085. Every message goes through this. Returns category + needsPlan + confidence. ~200ms. Handles all routing decisions including whether a request needs multi-step planning.
router.layer2: Keyword heuristics (FALLBACK) — only fires when 4B is unavailable (EVO down, circuit breaker open). Category-specific regex patterns. Cannot detect needsPlan.
router.layer3: Keyword fallback + cloud/local fallback handling — the old 0.6B classifier on port 8081 is not the active primary route. If the 4B classifier is unavailable, deterministic keyword heuristics and safer defaults take over.
router.layer4: Default response model — Qwen3.6-27B local on EVO. MiniMax is the cloud fallback; Claude is explicit/premium/last-resort when configured.
router.writeDetection: Any mutation intent (email drafts, calendar creates, soul changes) forces Claude — hallucinated args from local models cause real damage.
router.learnedRules: Persisted learned keyword rules (data/learned-rules.json) are still loaded every 5 minutes, but the old scheduled self-improvement cycle is no longer the main governing mechanism.
router.secretaryMode: 'clawdsec' prefix bypasses the task planner entirely — needsPlan forced false regardless of what the 4B classifier thinks. Fast path for simple admin: check calendar, add todo, search email.

modelSelection.qwen_default: Qwen3.6-27B on EVO port 8080 — default local chat model for normal non-image responses, using llama.cpp/Vulkan with speculative decoding.
modelSelection.minimax_fallback: MiniMax M2.7 — cloud fallback when Qwen is unreachable or unsuitable. Anthropic-compatible API.
modelSelection.claude_premium: Claude Opus 4.6 — premium model, only on explicit request ('ask claude', 'use opus') or as last-resort fallback when configured.
modelSelection.local_support: EVO models handle default chat, classification/planning support, vision/document paths, structured document parsing, and embeddings.
modelSelection.classifier_4b: Qwen3-4B on EVO (port 8085) — primary router. Category + needsPlan for every message. ~200ms.
